test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A person crosses a 900-metre long street in 6 minutes. The speed of the person in km/h is:
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the street = 900 m = 0.9 km

Time = 6 min = (6/60) = 1/10 hours

**Concept used:**

1 km = 1000 m

1 hour = 60 min

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Required speed = (0.9/1/10) km/h

⇒ (0.9 × 10) km/h

⇒ 9 km/h

**∴ The speed of the person is 9 km/h**
